items.name: Vardagscubing III - Ålidenskolan Open B 2023
items.information: Varmt välkommen till den tredje svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, i samarbete med Ålidenskolan i Flen! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 18 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Tävlingen, som hålls på en **fredag**, pågår endast i 3,5 timmar. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information. **OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen. **OBS:** Notera att du bara får anmäla dig till (och delta på) en av de två tävlingarna som hålls i Flen denna dag. -- A warm welcome to the third Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, in collaboration with Ålidenskolan in Flen! The competition has a very special format, where each participant has a total of 18 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Friday**, lasts only 3,5 hours. Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information. **N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition. **N.B:** Note that you may only register for (and participate in) one of the two competitions held in Flen that day.

items.name: A New Year in Hamilton 2023
items.information: A New Year in Hamilton 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

items.information: [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the first Cape Town competition for 2023. Dust off your cubes and get ready to set some PB's - or even records! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make payment by buying a ticket on our [Quicket](https://www.quicket.co.za/events/202509-cubingza-cape-cubes-summer-2023) page. ### SPECTATORS Competitors are welcome to bring up to two spectators with them. ### VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ### SPONSORSHIP ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbU10IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--03db2d12875f7b21e073b29649b48a5bc813b0e2/image.png) A big thanks to [Speedcubes](https://www.speedcubes.co.za/) who are sponsoring vouchers as a part of the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to try out and buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. #### About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact). We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.information: Välkommen till Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022, som hålls i centrala Stockholm. Detta är din chans att bli av med de extra kalorierna från julmaten de närmasta dagarna innan tävlingen! Alla är varmt välkomna att tävla, men vänligen läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida för att se till att du inte missar någon viktig information om tävlingen. ### Vänligen notera: * **3x3x3 FMC kan inte kombineras med någon annan gren. 4x4x4 BLD och 5x5x5 BLD kan inte kombineras med 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (och vice versa).** * **Varje deltagare får ta med högst en gäst till denna tävling. Varje gäst måste betala en inträdesavgift på 30 SEK för att få komma in i lokalen.** Läs "extra registration requirements" för mer information. * **Lokalen ligger i en kontorsarbetsplats med hög fysisk säkerhet och du kommer inte att kunna komma och gå som du vill.** Du måste antingen anlända till ytterdörren senast fem minuter innan den första grenen ska starta, eller ge dig själv gott om tid innan din första gren för att se till att någon har tid att släppa in dig. Information om telefonnummer till utvalda Hive Streaming-anställda kommer att mailas till dig dagen innan tävlingen, i fall du behöver ringa någon för att släppa in dig på kontoret. * **Notera att du bara får anmäla dig till (och delta på) en av de två tävlingarna som hålls i Stockholm denna dag.** --- Welcome to Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022, held in downtown Stockholm. This is your chance to work off some of those extra calories from the Christmas food of the past few days! Everyone is warmly welcome to compete, but please read through all tabs on this site to make sure you don't miss any important information about the competition. ### Please note: * **3x3x3 FMC can not be combined with any other event. 4x4x4 BLD and 5x5x5 BLD can not be combined with 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (and vice versa).** * **Every competitor can bring at most one guest to this competition. Every attending guest will have to pay an entry fee of 30 SEK to be allowed inside the venue.** Please read the extra registration requirements for more information. * **The venue is an office workplace with a high level of physical security, and you will not be able to come and go as you please.** You must either arrive at the front door no later than five minutes before the first event is scheduled to start, or give yourself ample time before your first event to make sure that someone can find the time to let you in. Details of contact phone numbers to selected Hive Streaming employees will be emailed to you the day before the competition, in case you need to call someone to let you in to the office. * **Note that you may only register for (and participate in) one of the two competitions held in Stockholm that day.**

items.information: # The competition was cancelled due to an unexpected situation of lack of resources, which made it both impossible and pointless to carry it out. ¡Te damos la bienvenida a **San Rafael Open 2022**! El cupo **máximo de competidores será de 100**, pudiéndose anotar a todas las categorías que deseen, pagando 1 sola inscripción. Rogamos **puntualidad**, recomendamos llegar 20 minutos antes de cada ronda, de esta manera evitamos demoras. --- Nuestro objetivo en este primer torneo oficial es que los competidores que asistan disfruten al máximo de la actividad, puedan aprender de sus compañeros, aprovechen a actualizar sus tiempos y sigan mejorando. Contamos con la experiencia de haber organizado desde el año 2018 Torneos, Talleres, Juegos, Actividades Cuberas, con nuestro Club Cuberos de Mendoza. Siempre deseábamos ofrecer un torneo oficial, pero los año en pandemia nos lo impidieron. Es por eso que soñamos de todo corazón que todos los competidores, familias, amigos, personas que asistan, disfruten de todo y se lleven una linda experiencia.

items.information: New Zealand Nationals 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. In addition, New Zealand Nationals 2022 will crown the National Champions in 16 WCA official events, over the course of 3 days.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. O uso de máscaras é recomendado! Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff. The use of facial masks is recommended

items.name: Vardagscubing I - Uppsala 2022
items.information: Varmt välkommen till den första svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, denna gång i Uppsala! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 20 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Tävlingen, som denna gång går på en **måndag** pågår endast i 4 timmar. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information. **OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen. -- Welcome to the first Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, this time in Uppsala! The competition has a very special format, where each participant has a total of 20 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Monday**, lasts only 4 hours. Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information. **N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

Mikäli järjestyksenvalvoja huomauttaa väkimäärästä, paikalta voidaan poistaa niitä joilla ei ole kaulanauhaa. At the venue there can be simultaneously 150 people at most. Every competitor may bring one guest with them. Competitors and their guests are given badges. Everyone else is welcome to the venue at all times as long as no more than 150 people is present at once. In case security officer notifys that there could be too many people those without badges could be denied entry to the venue.

items.name: Kewbz UK Championship 2022
items.information: ## Welcome to Kewbz UK Championship 2022! ### This year's UK National Championship ##### Spectators are welcome! Please read the information below, and the information in the [Spectators and Guests](#22468-spectators-and-guests) tab. If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. **Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Kewbz UK Championship 2022, you'll receive a completely free UK Championship t-shirt as a memento! You will receive this on registration at the venue, where you can choose your size. **Guests:** Guests will **only** be permitted to attend by paying a **£5** fee **at the competition**. Competitors will receive lanyards, and their guests and spectators will receive wristbands, which are to be worn throughout the weekend for security reasons. **This includes parents/guardians of competitors.** The fee must be paid at the competition and cannot be prepaid beforehand. The guest field in the registration form is for informational purposes only, the fee must be paid at the competition. **Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements in an official WCA competition by *17th October 2022*, you will not be eligible to compete in those events. Please see the **Events** tab to see these requirements. Please note that **new competitors can only compete in 3x3, 2x2, Skewb and Pyraminx**. **Final Round Advancements:** For all events with more than one round we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1 - 6 UK competitors; 3x3 - 8 UK competitors. 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded has a Top 16 qualification requirement, similarly this must contain at least 6 UK competitors. **Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Kewbz UK Championship FMC 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionshipFMC2022) on 22nd October instead. The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Kewbz UK Championship 2022. We will be taking videos and photographs of the competition and the environment for our social media pages and website. Media persons will also be in attendance. By attending the competition as a competitor or a guest, you are accepting that you may be filmed or photographed for these purposes. **Please Note:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. [![Kewbz](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/679033331912015892/1005532291797352509/RGB_FINAL_UKC_2022_LOGO_FOR_SCREENS.png)](https://kewbz.co.uk)

items.information: Välkomna till Svenska Mästerskapen 2022! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 7 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Det blir i år en 2,5-dagarstävling med alla WCA-grenar utom en, 3x3x3 FMC. Den Svenska Mästaren i den grenen kommer krönas på den separata tävlingen [Swedish FMC Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2022). Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Tävlande av alla nationaliteter är välkomna, men bara deltagare som representerar Sverige kan vinna medaljer, priser och titeln Svensk Mästare. *Notera vänligen också att klockan ställs* ***tillbaka*** *en timme till vintertid i Sverige natten mot söndag den 30:e oktober, vilket betyder en timmes längre sömn!* ----- Welcome to the Swedish Championship 2022! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 7 seconds or 5 minutes. This year there will be a 2,5-day competition with all WCA events but one, 3x3x3 FMC. The Swedish Champion in this event will be crowned at the separate competition [Swedish FMC Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2022). We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, but only participants representing Sweden can win medals, prizes and the title of Swedish Champion. *Please also note that the clock is set* ***back*** *one hour to winter time in Sweden on the night before Sunday October 30th, which means an hour more sleep!*

items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Open 2022 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, Alexander Helbok, Sanio Kasumovic und delegiert von Niko Ronkainen. Diesmal findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Falls Ihr Gäste dabei habt, würden wir euch bei der Anmeldung im Kommentarfeld um die Namen eure Gäste bitten. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** We are happy to announce the Vienna Open 2022 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, Alexander Helbok, Sanio Kasumovic and delegated by Niko Ronkainen. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. If you bring any guests, please write their names in the comments of your registration.

items.information: # Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. # All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue: ##### 1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Sunday, September 4th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. ##### **OR** ##### 2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Wednesday, September 14th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. #### ##### Along with a full vaccination or negative test document, a valid ID must be shown and checked at the registration desk on the day of the competition. Any proof sent electronically to the organizers and/or delegates prior to the competition will not be accepted. ##### Please enter through the entrance in the front of the venue next to the American Legion Way pillar. items.information: 8 años después de nuestra última competición, os presentanos el Rubik Mallorca Open 2022. Un torneo de speedcubing en esta maravillosa isla del mediterraneo donde podrás disfrutar de 2 días de competicion con rondas de casi todas las categorías oficiales, que se realizarán en el mismo hotel en que podrás hospedarte. En la edición de 2014 contamos con hasta 6 nacionalidades diferentes, y ahora ha llegado el momento de superarlo. ¡Os estaremos esperando! 8 years after our last competition, we are glad to present you the Rubik Mallorca Open 2022. A speedcubing tournament on this wonderful Mediterranean island where you'll be able to enjoy 2 days of competition with rounds of almost all official categories, which will take place in the same venue you'll stay. In the 2014 edition we had up to 6 different nationalities, and we plan to overcome it this year. So don't be afraid to join us. We'll be waiting for you!

items.information: We're excited to welcome new and experienced cubers to Cloverdale, B.C., for the Cloverdale Open 2022 cubing competition. We'll be raising funds for the [Cloverdale Community Kitchen](https://www.mycck.ca), an organization that feeds the hungry, and provides care for individuals when they are struggling. items.information: ## Registration Please register for the competition via the World Cube Association website before attending the competition in order to speed up the registration process on the day. Also note that the competitor limit is set at **100 competitors**. Please register and pay early in order to secure your place in the competition. We are allowing on-the-day registrations but please be aware that if you arrive on the day without registering and/or paying for your entry ticket, we cannot guarantee that you will be able to compete if the competitor limit has been reached. Tickets to compete start at **R 200.00**. Please pay online at https://fayview.com/product/wca-gauteng-autumn-participant/. Please note that we will not confirm your registration until you have paid for your entry ticket! Three ticket types are available: - **R 200** allows you to compete in the competition. - **R 250** allows you to compete, and also allows you access to a VIP lounge with non-alcoholic drinks and finger foods throughout the day, as well as couches, seating and a TV screen displaying results. - **R 450** includes both of the above, and also includes a competition T-Shirt. ## Guests Tickets for spectators are available here: https://fayview.com/product/wca-gauteng-autumn-spectator/ - **R 25** ticket will allow you access to the main competition area as a spectator. - **R 100** will also allow you access to the VIP lounge. - **R 300** includes both of the above, and also includes a competition T-Shirt. ## Other Information Also note that Covid protocols will be in place. Each competitor and vistors will be required to wear face masks and to sanitise regularly. The competition is sponsored by Speedcubes.co.za, and some puzzles will be available for sale at the competition.

items.information: [FR] En accord avec la politique de santé publique et les directives de l'ÉTS, tous les compétiteurs et leurs accompagnateurs devront porter un masque à l'intérieur des bâtiments. Le port du couvre-visage en tissu est interdit. Dans l'éventualité où les directives changent, les compétiteurs seront avisés par courriel. Portez une attention particulière à l'onglet Santé & Sécurité. **Les étudiants de l'ÉTS peuvent s'inscrire sans frais**. Si vous êtes étudiant de l'ÉTS, vous devez réserver votre place sur le [portail de réservation](https://reservation.etsmtl.ca/Accueil.aspx) dans monÉTS dans la section "Activités de la vie étudiante". Vous devez enregistrer au plus tard le vendredi 15 avril à 15h. Une fois que c'est fait j'aurais la liste des étudiants qui n'auront pas besoin de payer. Vous devez donc ensuite vous inscrire sur le site web WCA en même temps que tout le monde, simplement vous n'aurez pas à payer les frais d'inscription. Je précise que vous devez enregister le plus tôt possible, car être enregistré sur le portail de réservation ne vous garantie pas une place dans la compétition. Il n'y aura **aucun remboursement en cas d'annulation** (à cause des frais de transaction). Cependant si vous vous inscrivez et que vous n'êtes finalement pas en mesure de venir, merci de nous en informer afin de donner la place à quelqu'un d'autre. Les personnes inscrites en file d'attente seront remboursées une fois la période d'inscription s'est fermée. [EN] As per the current public health policy and the directives of the university, all competitors and their guest must wear a mask at all time inside the buildings. Wearing a cloth mask is prohibited. We will send registered competitors further details in an email if the regulations change. Take clear note especially of the Health and Safety Tab. **ETS students may compete for free**. If you are an ETS student, you must reserve your place on the [reservation portal](https://reservation.etsmtl.ca/Accueil.aspx) on monÉTS in the "Activités de la vie étudiante" section. You must register there by Friday, April 15 at 15h. Once you register there I will have the list of students who do not need to pay. You can then register on the WCA site without paying the fee. You should register as quickly as possible, as being registered on the monÉTS portal does not guarantee you a place in the competition. There will be **no refunds in case of cancellation** (due to transaction fees) . However, if you register and you are not able to come, please let us know so we can give the spot to someone else. You will still be refunded if you are still on the waiting list when the the registration period closes.

items.information: Day 1 (April 1st) will be located in the Senate Chamber of the Ohio Union. The Senate Chamber is on the west side of the second floor next to the Archie M Griffin West Ballroom. If you need help locating the Senate Chamber, there is a help desk on the first floor, as well as multiple maps around the building. Days 2 and 3 (April 2nd and 3rd) will be located in the East Auditorium of the Rhodes Center at the Ohio Expo Center. A map of the expo center will be provided in the **Travel** tab. **Day 1:** 3x3x3 Fewest Moves **Day 2:** 5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Square-1, Face-Turning Octahedron, Mirror Blocks **Day 3:** 3x3x3 Cube, 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, Pyraminx, Skewb Due to venue constraints, we will be enforcing a competitor limit of **38** for 3x3x3 Fewest Moves on a first come, first serve basis. Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue: 1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Friday, March 18th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. OR 2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Monday, March 28th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. **Refund Information: Due to venue financial requirements, no refunds will be issued after March 3rd, 2022 unless there are extreme circumstances. These circumstances include the following: ** * **Competitor contracts COVID-19 within 14 days of the competition and must withdraw** * **Other Injury or Sickness that would prevent the competitor from attending** * **Competition as a whole is cancelled** * **Any specific excuse deemed acceptable by an organizer or delegate** **We understand that some may need to cancel their registration after the refund date due to unforseen events or circumstances; however, due to financial constraints, we will only be refunding competitors if they meet one of the previously mentioned conditions. We thank you for your understanding.**

Nuestra prioridad es garantizar la seguridad y el bienestar de nuestros competidores y organizadores durante el desarrollo de la competencia de speedcubing. Por este motivo, es necesario cumplir con todos los protocolos establecidos por el gobierno y las autoridades sanitarias de Costa Rica y por la WCA. **A las personas que estaban inscritas en Costa Rica Regresa (v1) se les solicita hacer el registro lo más rápido posible ** Por tal motivo se tomará la temperatura a la entrada de la competencia. El uso de mascarilla es obligatorio en todo momento dentro de la competencia. Se solicitará carné de vacunación a los mayores de 12 años. Solo se permitirá un acompañante por persona. Cada competidor deberá llevar su propio lapicero. Se recomienda llevar más de una mascarilla en caso de ser necesario o bien para hacer un recambio. **.....................English version...................** Costa Rica Regresa V2 2022 will be the first official competition after the pandemic in the country. Our priority is to ensure the safety and well-being of our competitors and staff during the development of the speedcubing competition. For this reason, it is necessary to comply with all the protocols established by the government and health authorities of Costa Rica and by the WCA. For this reason, the temperature will be taken at the entrance of the competition. The use of a mask is mandatory at all times within the competition. Vaccination card will be requested from those over 12 years of age. We will only allow one companion per person. Each competitor must bring their own pen. We reccomend bringing more than one face mask.

items.information: **REGISTRO** A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos: 1. Tomar todos os cuidados referente ao COVID-19 e seguir o que será indicado pelo delegado e organizador da competição; 2. Conhecer as regras da WCA, pois é uma competição oficial; 3. Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Preste atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites; 4. Se inscrever através do site da WCA. A inscrição terá custo de R$ 30,00 (inscrição+camiseta) para os competidores pagos nos dias da competição durante o credenciamento. 5. Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (welbertmoutta@hotmail.com), bem como o delegado por meio do e-mail (gsantos@worldcubeassociation.org). O acesso ao local será permitido mediante comprovação de esquema vacinal completo, ou, uma dose de vacina e teste negativo para Covid-19 do tipo PCR, realizado até 48 horas antes do ingresso no local, ou do tipo antígeno, realizado até 24 horas antes do ingresso no estabelecimento (para o competidor e o acompanhante). Para as crianças menores de 12 anos, será solicitado o teste negativo de Covid-19 do tipo PCR, realizado até 48 horas antes do ingresso no estabelecimento, ou do tipo antígeno, realizado até 24 horas antes do acesso ao local. **REGISTRATION** The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements: 1. Take all precautions regarding COVID-19 and follow what will be indicated by the delegate and the organizer; 2. Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition; 3. Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind. 1. Register through the WCA website.The registration fee is R$30,00 (registration+shirt) and must be paid on the days of competition during the registration. 5. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (welbertmoutta@hotmail.com), or the delegate via email (gsantos@worldcubeassociation.org). Access to the venue will be allowed upon proof of the complete vaccination schedule, or a dose of vaccine and negative test for Covid-19 of the PCR type, took up to 48 hours before entering the venue, or of the antigen type, took up to 24 hours before entry into the establishment (for both competitor and companion). For children under 12 years of age, a negative Covid-19 PCR test will be required, took within 48 hours before entering the establishment, or an antigen test took within 24 hours before entering the venue.

items.information: **Español:** NO SE DEBE ASISTIR A LA COMPETENCIA CON SÍNTOMAS DE LA ENFERMEDAD COVID-19. Hay un límite de 30 competidores para el registro. * Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes. * Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad, a nuevos y viejos competidores, sin importar los tiempos de resolución. * Por razones sanitarias, no estarán permitidos los acompañantes a menos que sea necesario y esté justificado debidamente (p.ej. menores de edad). Máximo un acompañante por persona. * La competencia funcionará de acuerdo a la [Política de Seguridad de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf), por lo tanto es importante que la lean para evitar inconvenientes, además, se debe tener en cuenta que el Delegado de la WCA puede descalificar a cualquier competidor cuyo comportamiento constituya un riesgo para la salud de los demás. No se realizan reembolsos por descalificación, según la regla [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1) del Reglamento de la WCA. * Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles. * Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la categoría, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento. * Leer toda la información disponible en esta página. **¡Importante!** **La competencia puede ser cancelada por la Junta Directiva de la WCA si la situación de la pandemia empeora.** Ante cualquier duda consultar al organizador o el Delegado de la WCA. **English:** YOU MUST NOT SHOW UP AT THE COMPETITION WITH SYMPTOMS OF THE COVID-19. Competitor limit: 30. * Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue. * This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age. * For safety reasons, guests won't be allowed inside the venue, unless a competitor requires a guest for any justified reason (e.g. minors). Only one guest per competitor allowed. * This competition will be held in accordance with the [WCA Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf). Please, remember that the WCA Delegate may disqualify any competitor that behaves in a way that is unsafe for other people's health inside the venue (see regulation [2k3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k3)). A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition (regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1)). Please read the WCA Safety Policy to avoid any issue. * Competitors must provide their own puzzles. * Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with the article [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations. * Read all the information available in this website. **Attention!** **The competition may be canceled by the WCA Board if the pandemic situation gets worse.** For any question, feel free to contact the organizer or the WCA Delegate.

items.information: Los resultados de este torneo ingresarán a la base de datos y al ranking de la WCA, y quienes participen por primera vez adquirirán un perfil oficial. Por esa razón, todos los competidores deben conocer el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). El Seminario Teológico Nazareno del Perú, es una institución evangélica dedicada a la preparación de ministros cristianos, y nos está brindando gentilmente sus instalaciones para la realización del torneo, por lo tanto, se les pide un comportamiento adecuado al Instituto Religioso. Se nos está permitido usar el lugar de ceremonias donde se realizará el torneo, transitar por los espacios abietos, y usar los baños. Pero está prohibido entrar a las aulas, oficinas y demás instalaciones del local. ____ The results of this competition will enter the data base and WCA ranking, and the ones participating for the first time will acquire an official profile. For that reason, every competitor must know the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). The Nazarene Theological Seminary of Peru is an evangelical institution dedicated to the preparation of Christian ministers, and are giving us kindly their facilities for the realization of the tournament, therefore, it is asked to have an appropriate behavior to the Religious Institute. We are allowed to use the place of ceremonies where the tournament will take place, go through the open spaces, and use the bathrooms. But it's forbidden to enter classrooms, offices and any other of the facilities.

items.information: ## Estimados competidores debido al incremento de casos Covid-19 la competencia para el 23 de enero será cancelada, ésta será reprogramada para Marzo, lamentamos el inconveniente que pueda ocasionar el cambio, favor coordinar con los organizadores la devolución del dinero si no puede participar en marzo. **Costa Rica Regresa 2022** será la primera competencia oficial despues de la pandemia en el país. Nuestra prioridad es garantizar la seguridad y el bienestar de nuestros competidores y organizadores durante el desarrollo de la competencia de speedcubing. Por este motivo, es necesario cumplir con todos los protocolos establecidos por el gobierno y las autoridades sanitarias de Costa Rica y por la WCA. Por tal motivo se tomará la temperatura a la entrada de la competencia. El uso de mascarilla es obligatorio en todo momento dentro de la competencia. Se solicitará carné de vacunación a los mayores de 12 años. Solo se permitirá un acompañante por persona. Cada competidor deberá llevar su propio lapicero. Se recomienda llevar más de una mascarilla en caso de ser necesario o bien para hacer un recambio. **.....................English version...................** ## Due to the increase in Covid-19 cases, the competition for January 23 will be canceled, it will be rescheduled for March. Costa Rica Regresa 2022 will be the first official competition after the pandemic in the country. Our priority is to ensure the safety and well-being of our competitors and staff during the development of the speedcubing competition. For this reason, it is necessary to comply with all the protocols established by the government and health authorities of Costa Rica and by the WCA. For this reason, the temperature will be taken at the entrance of the competition. The use of a mask is mandatory at all times within the competition. Vaccination card will be requested from those over 12 years of age. We will only allow one companion per person. Each competitor must bring their own pen. We reccomend bringing more than one face mask.

Con protocolos de Bioseguridad de las Autoridades Locales y los establecidos por la WCA, GuateMaya busca mantener el desarrollo del speedcubing en Guatemala de la forma mas segura posible para todos nuestros competidores y asistentes. - Se tomará la temperatura a la entrada de la competencia. - El uso de mascarilla es obligatorio en todo momento dentro de la competencia. - Se solicitará carné de vacunación a los mayores de 12 años With GuateMaya 2021 we hope to return to hold official competitions regularly in the country. Using Covid-19 protocols from the local authorities and those sugested by the WCA, GuateMaya 2021 looks forward to improving the local development of the speedcubing in Guatemala, guaranteeing the safety of the competitors and staff. -Temperature will be measured at the entrance -Use of masks will be mandatory during all the competition -Vaccination proof will be required to enter to the venue

items.information: Velkomin! Ef þetta er fyrsta skipti sem þið eruð að keppa gerir WCA kröfu um **löggild skilríki** í skráningarferlinu. Please read the [COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IcelandicNationals2021#16925-covid-19) information tab! items.information: **Español:** NO SE DEBE ASISTIR A LA COMPETENCIA CON SÍNTOMAS DE LA ENFERMEDAD COVID-19. Hay un límite de 30 competidores para el registro. * Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes. * Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad, a nuevos y viejos competidores y sin importar los tiempos de resolución. * Por razones sanitarias, no estarán permitidos los acompañantes a menos que sea necesario y esté justificado debidamente (p.ej. menores de edad). De ser posible los acompañantes deberán permanecer fuera del local. * La competencia funcionará de acuerdo a la [Política de Seguridad de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf), por lo tanto es importante que la lean para evitar inconvenientes, además, se debe tener en cuenta que el Delegado de la WCA puede descalificar a cualquier competidor cuyo comportamiento constituya un riesgo para la salud de los demás. No se realizan reembolsos por descalificación, según la regla [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1) del Reglamento de la WCA. * Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles, de acuerdo con el punto 2.6 de la [Política de Seguridad de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf). * Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la categoría, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo al artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento. **¡Importante!** **La competencia puede ser cancelada por la Junta Directiva de la WCA si la situación de la pandemia empeora.** Ante cualquier duda consultar al organizador o el Delegado de la WCA. **English:** YOU MUST NOT SHOW UP AT THE COMPETITION WITH SYMPTOMS OF THE COVID-19. Competitor limit: 30. * Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue. * This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age. * For safety reasons, guests won't be allowed inside the venue, unless a competitor requires a guest for any justified reason (e.g. minors). In that case, guests should remain outdoors. * Competition will be held in accordance with the [WCA Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf). Please, remember that the WCA Delegate may disqualify any competitor that behaves in a way that is unsafe for other people's health inside the venue (see regulation [2k3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k3)). A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition (regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1)). Please read the WCA Safety Policy to avoid any issue. * Competitors must provide their own puzzles in accordance with 2.6 of the [WCA Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf). * Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with the article [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations. **Attention!** **The competition may be canceled by the WCA Board if the pandemic situation gets worse.** For any question, feel free to contact the organizer or the WCA Delegate.

items.name: Richmond Open B 2021
items.information: As per BC's recently announced [Proof of Vaccination Requirement](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/covid-19/vaccine/proof), All attendees are required to have **FULL vaccination (2 doses)** by the event date otherwise, you will NOT be allowed to enter the venue. Please **review ALL of the tabs listed on this website**. This is a priority. **Even if you are a seasoned competitor, COVID-19 has created some new shifts** and there are things to be particularly attentive to. Note that this is a **one of a pair of series competitions**. Series competitions (formerly known as twin competitions) are relatively new to BC. Please see the Series Competiton Tab for more information. Take clear note especially of the Health and Safety Tab, containing our Risk Mitigation Plan. Note: **Spectators (max 1 per competitor)** can attend for free. Those aged 18+ are invited to consider not attending with a guest to help our venue capacity numbers as low as possible. **If you're not a competitor, nor the single guest of a competitor, then we ask you NOT to come.** Note: As the pandemic is an ever-evolving situation, there is of course the possibility that we will need to increase safety precautions or, in the worst case, cancel the competition. **Please be aware that changes may be needed.** Email will be sent out to registered competitors about significant changes. In the event of cancellation we will do our best to provide full refunds to everyone.

See the "Twin Competitions" tab for more details. # ***IMPORTANT: COVID SAFETY REQUIREMENTS*** Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue: 1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Sunday, November 21st is insufficient for entrance to the competition. OR 2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Wednesday, December 1st is insufficient for entrance to the competition. Along with a full vaccination or negative test document, a valid ID must be shown and checked at the registration desk on the day of the competition. items.name: Norrkubing 2021
items.information: This is the 2021 edition of Norrkubing. A competition which history started in 2015, and this is the 6th time a competition has been organized in this municipality. The competition is open to everyone but limited to 25 competitors due to regulations regarding covid-19. Please read through all the tabs on this site carefully, as they contain very useful about the competition. This includes especially the COVID-19 tab, with the measures in place to limit the spread of the virus at the competition. Note that members of SveKub have a 25% discount on the registration fee. The membership is free, although a Swedish personal number is needed, more information can be found on the SveKub website. Lastly, we would like to remind you that the COVID-19 situation is very uncertain, and that late changes including a cancellation of the competition on short notice can't be ruled out. Therefore, please keep an eye on this website and your email to receive the latest information, and keep in mind that the organizers will only be able to refund the registration fee, not personal travel expenses. ----- Detta är 2021 års upplaga av Norrkubing. Tävlingen arrangerades för första gången år 2015, och detta är den sjätte gången en tävling arrangeras i denna kommun. Tävlingen är öppen för alla men begränsad till maximalt 25 deltagare på grund av restriktioner kring covid-19. Läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida noga, då de innehåller mycket värdefull information om tävlingen. Detta gäller särskilt fliken COVID-19, med de smittoskyddsåtgärder som kommer gälla under tävlingen. Notera även att medlemmar i SveKub har 25% rabatt på anmälningsavgiften. Att bli medlem är gratis, mer information finns på Svekubs hemsida. Slutligen vill vi påminna om att COVID-19 situationen är mycket osäker, och att sena förändringar inklusive att tävlingen ställs in med kort varsel tyvärr inte går att utesluta. Håll därför nära koll på denna hemsida samt er email för att få den senaste informationen och kom ihåg att arrangörerna endast kan återbetala anmälningsavgiften, inte personliga reseutgifter.

De ser posible los acompañantes deberán permanecer fuera del local. * La competencia funcionará de acuerdo a la [Política de Seguridad de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf), por lo tanto es importante que la lean para evitar inconvenientes. Competitor limit: 35. * Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid possible issues. * This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age. * For safety reasons, guests won't be allowed inside the venue, unless a competitor requires a guest for any justified reason (e.g. minors). Please, remember that the WCA Delegate may disqualify any competitor that behaves in a way that is unsafe for other people's health inside the venue. So, please read the WCA Safety Policy to avoid any issue. * Competitors must provide their own puzzles in accordance with 2.6 of the [WCA Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf). * Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with the article [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations. **Important!** **The competition may be canceled by the WCA Board if the pandemic situation gets worse.** For any question, contact the organizer or the WCA Delegate.

items.information: Välkommen till de första tävlingarna att arrangeras i tvillingformat i Sverige! Denna tävling hör ihop med [Flen - Stora Manschetten 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenStoraManschetten2021), och det är endast tillåtet att anmäla sig och tävla i en av dessa två tävlingar. Mer information om detta finns under fliken [Tvillingtävling](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenLillaManschetten2021#16202-tvillingtavling-twin-competition). Läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida noga, då de innehåller mycket värdefull information om tävlingen. Detta gäller särskilt fliken [COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenLillaManschetten2021#16171-covid-19), med de smittoskyddsåtgärder som kommer gälla under tävlingen. Notera även att medlemmar i SveKub har 25% rabatt på anmälningsavgiften. Att bli medlem är gratis, mer information finns på Svekubs [hemsida](https://svekub.se/). Slutligen vill vi påminna om att COVID-19 situationen är mycket osäker, och att sena förändringar inklusive att tävlingen ställs in med kort varsel tyvärr inte går att utesluta. Håll därför nära koll på denna hemsida samt er email för att få den senaste informationen och kom ihåg att arrangörerna endast kan återbetala anmälningsavgiften, inte personliga reseutgifter. ----- Welcome to the first ever twin competitions in Sweden! This competition is twinned with [Flen - Stora Manschetten 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenStoraManschetten2021), and competitors may only register for and compete in one out of these two competitions. More on this can be found under the [Twin competitions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenLillaManschetten2021#16202-tvillingtavling-twin-competition) tab. Please read through all the tabs on this site carefully, as they contain very useful about the competition. This includes especially the [COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenLillaManschetten2021#16171-covid-19) tab, with the measures in place to limit the spread of the virus at the competition. Note that members of SveKub have a 25% discount on the registration fee. The membership is free, although a Swedish personal number is needed, more information can be found on the SveKub [website](https://svekub.se/). Lastly, we would like to remind you that the COVID-19 situation is very uncertain, and that late changes including a cancellation of the competition on short notice can't be ruled out. Therefore, please keep an eye on this website and your email to receive the latest information, and keep in mind that the organizers will only be able to refund the registration fee, not personal travel expenses.

items.information: # This competition has been cancelled. # The date for this competition has changed to August 20-21, 2021. Please familiarize yourself with the [Safety Plan] (https://docs.google.com/document/d/1vgSyWUwrL1MkixikzJqiZXodSBejV2S39T_18PCm5-E/edit). 1. If COVID-19 cases drop to below 10 cases / 100,000 residents within two weeks of the competition, the competition will continue as announced. 2. If COVID-19 cases are between 10 and 20 cases / 100,000 residents within two weeks of the competition, the competition will continue, but all attendees (spectators and competitors) must show either proof of full vaccination (2 weeks since last shot of 1 or 2 dose series) or have a negative COVID-19 test within 96 hours of the beginning of the event, or after 8:00am Eastern on Monday, August 16th, 2021. There are no exceptions. 3. If COVID-19 cases are greater than 20 cases / 100,000 residents within two weeks of the competition, the competition will not continue and we will either reschedule or cancel at that time. # Maximum one spectator per competitor. ## This competition’s registration and waitlist is full. We are very excited to announce the inaugural Pennsylvania Championship! Join us for a very sweet weekend of cubing and fun in historic Hershey Pennsylvania. We will have two special unofficial events as well as the option to have a day at HersheyPark on Sunday with all of your friends. This is the state championship for Pennsylvania, however, anyone can attend. All state champion titles are unofficial and are **not** recognized by the World Cube Association or CubingUSA. For more information on state champion eligibility, see the [PA Title eligibility tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PennsylvaniaChampionship2021#14358-pa-title-eligibility). Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations Live results can be found on our WCA Live page, which will be available during the competition. Before registering, you must read the "Competitor Information" tab. This tab details the responsibilites of all competitors at this competition. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. items.name: Copper Country Cubing Summer 2021

venue.name: [MTU Memorial Union Building](https://www.mtu.edu/memorialunion/)
venue.address: Memorial Union Building, 1400 Townsend Dr, Houghton, MI 49931

items.information: This is the fourth Copper Country Cubing competition, and we're looking forward to welcoming you to the Michigan Upper Peninsula! It's been a long time since anyone has been able to compete, so this event features two long events on Saturday evening and the more common NxN events on Sunday. We plan to host another competition this Fall with more of the non-NxN puzzles, so look out for it! As this competition takes place on the Michigan Technology University campus, it is subject to Michigan state laws, University campus policies, and WCA policies. We will monitor all of these sources for any changes to safety protocols and requirements. Please note that if community or regional health problems surface again or severely worsen, the competition may be forced to cancel. There is a 40 person Competitor Limit for this competition. Please sign up early to ensure a spot, and please read the "Waiting List" tab for additional information on registration for the competition. If the competition is running ahead of schedule and has enough competitors we would love to add an additional round to 3BLD, 3OH, and/or 6x6. Additionally, please note that the rounds are scheduled with more time than usual to account for stationary groups and sanitation time. **YOU MUST READ THE COVID SAFETY TAB PRIOR TO REGISTERING.**

items.information: #### Рубик шооны Монгол улсын аварга шалгаруулах албан ёсны нээллтэй тэмцээн This competition is the official Championship of Mongolia. items.information: New Zealand Nationals 2020 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. items.information: #Tävlingen har ställts in på grund av ökat antal rapporterade fall av COVID-19 i Sverige.# Välkomna till Svenska Öppna 2020! Det är endast tillåtet att tävla på en av de två tävlingarna Swedish Open Side Events A eller B.
